why: Takes `box-sizing: border-box` off the primitive. A <button> is border-box in Chromium anyway, so every button still measures exactly 44 px and the floor looks correct -- but the two `<a class="ui-btn">` links in About & Legal are content-box, and their padding lands on top of the floor. The first Chromium sweep of issue #686 caught exactly that: those links grew from 48 px to 56 px, a control grown past its design rather than raised to the floor.
killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole keeps every menu control at the 44px touch floor (issue #686)
